about: Boiarka: a forest suburb of private houses

Boiarka is surrounded by forest, and most requests here are about a private house: building a new one, adding a floor or putting in order a house bought as a fixer-upper. There are fewer apartments than in neighbouring Vyshneve, although new complexes are appearing too.

Some plots in Boiarka and the villages around are former dachas with thin walls and no proper systems. For them we honestly calculate which is better value: insulate and rebuild, or put up a new house.

For a house in Boiarka the design often covers the façade and the plot too: large windows onto the forest, a terrace, an entrance with a vestibule. Inside — a fireplace or stove, a kitchen with an island and walk-in wardrobes, as in our Petrivtsi House. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate houses and apartments: new services, insulation, levelled walls, finishing — for houses with a history, after a survey. We build from aerated block and brick, as well as [log houses](/en/timber-house) that look natural in the forest, designing around the trees on the plot and the groundwater level.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: Do you do the engineering systems in a house?
Yes: heating, water supply, sewerage and electrics go into the house project and estimate.
Do you build houses in Boiarka and the surrounding area?
Yes: architectural design from $12 per m², shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m².
Is it better to rebuild an old house or build a new one?
It depends on the foundation and walls. After a survey we give an estimate for both options, so you decide with the numbers in hand.
